email.subject1: a signal play for White Cup
email.body1:
Clifton, saw White Cup is embedding AI directly inside the CRM + BI distributors already work in, with open demos running every month.

Pushing a new AI story usually means more distributors worth a conversation than a regional team can actually cover, and that is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for White Cup off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Clifton, quick follow-up for White Cup.

When the product story gets louder, the number usually moves faster than the headcount you can add to chase it. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings each rep needs to hit target, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings White Cup needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Clifton, last bit of proof for White Cup.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how White Cup's reply rate likely compares to other vertical-SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Clifton, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling distributor pipeline without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and rolling out a new AI motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your distribution motion? I will tailor it to White Cup either way.
